instances.claim: This tells me that collectors decide which Cents matter because of the marks of touch and time the individual Cents have accumulated.
instances.why: Line 19 holds the decision expression ('deciding which Cents matter', attributed to collectors); line 18 immediately precedes it with a property of the objects ('now bearing the marks of touch and time'), and the draft states no reason anywhere for how collectors select — line 17's 'own logics and rarities' is another property, not a stated motive. Each line alone is innocent: 18 only reports wear, 19 only reports that selection happens; placed in this order the wear becomes the criterion.
